**Job Title:** Software/AI Engineer  
**Location:** Egypt (Seero Engineering Consulting Office)  
**Job Type:** Full\-time

**About Seero Engineering Consulting**  
Seero is a leading multidisciplinary engineering consultancy, delivering innovative solutions across buildings, infrastructure, and industrial projects. We are committed to integrating advanced digital technologies, artificial intelligence, and software solutions to enhance efficiency, sustainability, and value in engineering and project delivery.

**Position Overview**  
We are seeking a talented **Software/AI Engineer** to join our Egypt office. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing software tools and AI\-driven solutions to support engineering workflows, data analysis, and digital transformation initiatives across Seero’s projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML models and software applications for engineering and project management.
* Automate processes related to BIM, project planning, resource management, and data analysis.
* Integrate AI solutions into existing systems, improving efficiency and decision\-making.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams (BIM, engineering, IT) to develop customized digital tools.
* Conduct research on emerging AI/ML technologies and evaluate their applications in engineering consultancy.
* Develop APIs, dashboards, and data visualization tools for project monitoring.
* Ensure scalability, performance, and security of developed solutions.

**Qualifications \& Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).
* 3–6 years of experience in software development and AI/ML model deployment.
* Strong programming skills (Python, C\#, Java, or similar).
* Experience with AI/ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit\-learn).
* Knowledge of BIM\-related software integration (Revit API, Dynamo, etc.) is a strong plus.
* Proficiency in database management and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud).
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

**Why Join Seero?**

* Opportunity to drive digital transformation in a leading engineering consultancy.
* Exposure to cutting\-edge AI and software applications in real\-world projects.
* Professional development and growth opportunities.
* Competitive compensation and benefits package.

Job Type: Full\-time

title: AI Engineer
description:
**AI Engineer**

 **Purpose of the Job**

This role is pivotal in our commitment to leveraging cutting\-edge artificial intelligence to advance our mission. This person will be a hands\-on professional with a passion for experimenting with emerging AI assistants, large language models (LLMs), and other AI technologies. This role will be responsible for identifying, testing, and integrating these tools into our existing technological infrastructure to enhance our programs, fundraising, streamline operations, and drive data\-informed decision\-making.

 **Essential Functions and Responsibilities**

* Analyze business processes using the workflow process management function and partner with Data Analysts to evaluate data flows, then proactively identify opportunities to integrate AI solutions that optimize efficiency, automate tasks, and support informed decision\-making.
* Research, experiment with, and evaluate emerging AI assistants, generative AI tools, and large language models (LLMs) to determine high\-value use cases aligned with organizational goals.
* Design and develop AI prototypes and proof\-of\-concept integrations to demonstrate how AI tools can be effectively integrated into internal systems to enhance efficiency, automation, and operational workflows.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to identify practical challenges and opportunities where AI can be applied to simplify work, save time, or improve outcomes.
* Build, fine\-tune, and deploy ML models tailored to nonprofit\-specific use cases such as donor insights, operational automation, and content generation.
* Use advanced Python skills and ML tools to develop and fine\-tune AI models for practical applications.
* Implement AI solutions in compliance with ethical standards, including bias mitigation, data privacy, and fairness, and contribute to shaping the organization's AI governance framework.
* Train non\-technical staff on basic AI concepts, opportunities, and risks.

Design and implement AI architecture, model integration strategies, and data pipelines to enable seamless deployment into existing systems.  
* 

  

**Required Education, Experience, Knowledge and Skills**

* Bachelor's in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Data Science, or a relevant field.
* 1 to 3 of hands\-on experience in machine learning, AI engineering, or related fields.
* Hands\-on experience working within project teams, supporting the implementation of AI solutions in coordination with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Proficiency in written and spoken English.
* Proficiency in Python and core ML frameworks.
* Practical experience with AI/LLM deployment, including Chabot's, assistants, or generative AI.
* Good understanding of data ethics, bias, and responsible AI principles.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and documentation skills.
* Experience with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems and their integration with data and AI workflows.
* Ability to gather, analyze and present information and numerical data effectively, and a demonstrated, high level of accuracy and thoroughness in all duties.

 **Travel and Working Requirements**

* Limited to typical office environment such as walking, sitting, typing, using office equipment, and occasional lifting of boxes or luggage during travel.
* Occasional travel, nationally or internationally, is expected.
* Working out of the official hours and on weekends may be required.

* Strong foundation in mathematics, statistics, and algorithms.
* Proficiency with ML/DL frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit\-learn).
* Experience with NLP, computer vision, and Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Knowledge of MLOps tools (MLflow, Docker) and CI/CD.
* Cloud deployment experience with AWS or Azure.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to work in a multidisciplinary team.

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:

**Your challenges:**
 AI Solution Development
   

  

* Design, build, and operate agentic LLM applications with tool\-use/function calling, planning, memory, and structured outputs with versioned prompts.
* Implement RAG pipelines (hybrid dense\+sparse retrieval, reranking); manage vector indices and the embedding lifecycle.
* Integrate models with internal services and third\-party APIs via tool adapters; enforce schema contracts and access controls.
* Lead feature work in recommendation/ranking, content generation/editing, and workflow orchestration backed by measurable eval metrics.


 Security \& Automation
   

  

* Build AI\-driven security automations: classifiers/anomaly detectors, red\-teaming harnesses, and (where appropriate) autonomous testing agents.
* Implement safety \& privacy controls: prompt\-injection/jailbreak defenses, PII redaction, policy filtering, and auditability.
* Stand up real\-time tracing \& alerts on token/latency/cost, retrieval degradation, drift, and hallucination risk.


 Project \& Task Management
   

  

* Own model/prompt/agent versioning and ship via CI/CD with canaries/A\-B, rollback plans, and clear SLOs (quality, latency, cost).
* Evolve workflows: PR\-based changes to prompts/configs, experiment tracking, concise design docs, and ADRs (decision records).


 Quality Assurance \& Code Review
   

  

* Enforce evaluation\-first development: golden sets, synthetic probes, regression tests for prompts, grounding/faithfulness checks.
* Review for determinism, observability, and reproducibility; address tech debt with a bias to stability and measured impact.


 Collaboration \& Mentorship
   

  

* Partner with platform/data teams on data contracts, retrieval standards, and tenancy/access control.
* Mentor peers on agent patterns, RAG, prompt engineering, and safe rollout; lead design reviews and share practical research findings.


 Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Benchmark and integrate new model families/tools via standardized bake\-offs; report quality–latency–cost trade\-offs.
* Optimize serving with adapters/LoRA, distillation/quantization, routing/caching/speculative decoding; right\-size infra for cost/perf.
* Track industry and research trends; convert into pragmatic, incremental stack upgrades.


**Requirements:**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* Strong programming skills in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar languages.
* Experience with AI/ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face).

* Excellent problem\-solving, communication, and leadership skills.
* Experience with task management and code collaboration tools (GitHub, Jira, ClickUp, etc.).
* Ability to work independently and as part of a fast\-paced, collaborative team.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience in AI/ML engineering, with a proven track record of delivering production\-grade solutions.
* Experience with marketing automation, content generation, or design systems.
* Familiarity with Figma, Supabase, or similar platforms.
* Contributions to open source AI/security projects.

title: AI Engineer
description:
**About Us** 




  





 Foundation is developing the future of general purpose robotics with the goal to address the labor shortage. https://foundation.bot
 



  





 Our mission is to create advanced robots that can operate in complex environments, reducing human risk in conflict zones and enhancing efficiency in labor\-intensive industries.
 



 We are on the lookout for extraordinary engineers and scientists to join our team.
 



  





 We expect that many of our team members will bring diverse perspectives from various industries and fields.
 



  





 We are looking for individuals with a proven record of exceptional ability and a history of creating things that work.
 



  





**Our Culture:** 




  





 We like to be frank and honest about who we are, so that people can decide for themselves if this is a culture they resonate with. Please read more about our culture here https://foundation.bot/culture.
 



  





**Who should join:** 




  




* You like working in person with a team in Munich, Germany.
* You deeply believe that this is the most important mission for humanity and needs to happen yesterday.
* You are highly technical \- regardless of the role you are in. We are building technology; you need to understand technology well.
* You care about aesthetics and design inside out. If it's not the best product ever, it bothers you, and you need to “fix” it.
* You don't need someone to motivate you nor give you tasks; you get things done.



  





**Why We Are Hiring for This Role:** 



* Develop software\-engineering solutions for the integration of machine\-learning models in robotics environments
* Develop intelligent perception and control models using VLMs, transformers, CNNs, RNNs, and RL to power robotic behaviors.
* Fine\-tune and adapt modern pre\-trained models for robotic vision, policy learning, etc.
* Use large\-scale pre\-trained networks to develop robust, generalizable ML pipelines.
* Integrate ML with real\-time control, combining traditional robotics methods with learned components.
* Use simulation environments like Isaac Sim and MuJoCo to prototype and evaluate models prior to real\-world deployment.
* Close the sim\-to\-real gap
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with controls, perception, systems, and hardware teams to bring ML\-driven robotics to life.
* Write high\-quality, scalable code in Python using ML frameworks like PyTorch and JAX; contribute to shared tooling and research infrastructure.



  





**What Kind of Person We Are Looking For:** 



* Very strong software\-engineering background in robotics
* Very strong experience using ROS 2
* Strong background in machine learning for vision and control.
* Deep experience with Python, PyTorch, and/or JAX; comfortable debugging, optimizing, and scaling ML systems.
* Experience with simulators like Isaac Sim or MuJoCo for training and testing robotics pipelines.
* Comfort integrating ML into control systems, including hybrid and end\-to\-end approaches.
* MSc or PhD in Machine Learning, Robotics, Computer Science, or related field—or equivalent practical experience
* Willingness to travel to customer sites as well as to US HQ.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Prior experience deploying pre\-trained models in embedded or edge environments.
* Familiarity with reinforcement learning in robotics applications.
* Interest in active perception, multi\-agent robotics, or HRI (human–robot interaction).
* Contributions to open\-source robotics and publications.

 The AI Team at Agile Robots is looking for a dedicated (Senior) Robotics AI Engineer (m/w/d) Computer Vision with strong expertise in computer vision and machine learning, with a particular focus on robotic understanding. You are expected to have 2 to 5 years of experience in the field, showing proficiency in working with large\-scale video datasets in the context of robotic learning. This position is at the intersection of AI and robotics, with a focus on enabling robots to learn effectively from video demonstrations and observations. Prior hands\-on experience in these areas would be a significant plus.
   

  

 Your Responsibilities
   

  

* AI Methods: Develop and improve deep learning, VLA\-based, or transformer\-based approaches for video learning in robotics.
* Synthetic Data: Design and implement synthetic robotic videos for large\-scale training data generation.
* Multimodality: Explore learning approaches that leverage video, audio, and sensory data.
* Integration: Collaborate with robotics engineers to embed video\-based learning methods into robotic systems.
* Architecture: Translate functional and technical requirements into detailed system architecture and design.


**Essential Skills**
* Education: Master’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, AI, Automation, or a related field.
* Computer Vision: Strong background in video understanding, action recognition, or video\-based imitation learning.
* Deep Learning: Proficiency in methods and frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow), ideally in video or multimodal contexts.
* Datasets: Experience with large\-scale video datasets, including preprocessing, annotation, and pipeline design.
* Programming: Familiarity with Python, software development practices and robotics frameworks (e.g., ROS2\).
* Soft Skills: Excellent problem\-solving abilities, collaborative mindset, and strong communication skills.


 Beneficial Skills
   

  

* Advanced Models: Experience with transformer\-based video models, diffusion models, or multimodal architectures.
* Motion Retargeting: Knowledge of motion retargeting methods in robotics.
* Model Deployment: Experience with serving frameworks such as TorchServe or TensorFlow Extended.
* DevOps: Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Publications: Track record of scientific publications in leading venues in ML, Computer Vision, or Robotics.


 What we offer
   

  

* Dynamic high\-tech company combined with financial soundness and world class investors.
* Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60\+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
* Lots of development opportunities in the context of our continued growth.
* Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
* Corporate Benefits Program that covers health, mobility and learning with 100 € net per month.
* Modern office facilites with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks \& fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment.


 Apply for this job

**Agile Robots SE** 
 is an international high\-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 2300 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state\-of\-the\-art force\-moment\-sensing and world\-leading image\-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user\-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly.

*Du hast Lust, die Zukunft der medizinischen Versorgung mitzugestalten und KI\-Lösungen zu entwickeln, die Diagnostik, Therapie und Prävention revolutionieren?*

*Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!*


LillianCare ist ein führendes Gesundheitsunternehmen, das innovative medizinische Lösungen durch die Kombination von traditioneller Hausarztmedizin und modernster Telemedizin bietet. Unsere Mission ist es, die medizinische Versorgung in ländlichen und unterversorgten Gebieten zu revolutionieren und zugänglich zu machen. Mit einem wachsenden Netzwerk von Partnerpraxen und einem engagierten Team von Fachärzten, PAs und MFAs streben wir danach, die Gesundheitslandschaft zu transformieren, indem wir qualitativ hochwertige Versorgung anbieten, die sowohl flexibel als auch integrativ ist.

AI Engineer (all genders)
zur Vollzeitanstellung.

#### **Aufgaben**

* Du entwickelst und verfeinerst unsere AI\-Strategie mit einem klaren Fokus auf Diagnostik\-, Therapie\- und Vorhersagemodelle.
* Große Mengen an Patientendaten aus PVS\-Systemen, Freitexten, Fragebögen, Laborwerten und Medikationsplänen bereitest Du so auf, dass sie sinnvoll integriert und genutzt werden können.
* Mit Machine Learning und LLMs baust Du Modelle, die patientenspezifische Vorhersagen ermöglichen – von Krankheitsrisiken über Therapievorschläge bis hin zum Versorgungsbedarf.
* Du entwickelst eine Wissensdatenbank, die medizinische Leitlinien, Fachliteratur und interne Datenquellen bündelt und für KI\-Modelle nutzbar macht.
* Gemeinsam mit unserem Produktteam bringst Du intelligente KI\-Funktionalitäten direkt in die Patienten\- und Praxis\-App, damit unsere Nutzer von smarten Vorschlägen und Entscheidungsunterstützung profitieren.
* Du achtest darauf, dass Datenschutz, Anonymisierung und regulatorische Vorgaben wie DSGVO, KBV/Gematik oder MDR jederzeit eingehalten werden.
* Du entwickelst Prototypen und Proof\-of\-Concepts, testest neue Technologien und bewertest deren Praxistauglichkeit.
* Die Performance Deiner Modelle behältst Du stets im Blick und bewertest sie anhand von Bias, Fairness, Genauigkeit und klinischer Relevanz.
* In enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Ärzten, MFAs und medizinischen Beratern stellst Du sicher, dass die entwickelten Lösungen auch im Praxisalltag funktionieren.
* Gemeinsam mit dem Team baust Du eine skalierbare AI\-Infrastruktur auf, die sowohl in der Cloud als auch On\-Premise betrieben werden kann.

* Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Data Science, Künstlicher Intelligenz oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet – oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation durch praktische Erfahrung.
* Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in Machine Learning, Deep Learning und Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Du hast Erfahrung in der Verarbeitung und Integration heterogener Datenquellen, idealerweise aus dem Gesundheitswesen, und beherrschst Datenaufbereitung, Feature Engineering und Modelltraining.
* Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Cloud\-Plattformen wie AWS, Google, Azure oder NVIDIA und hast Erfahrungen mit deren AI\-Tools.
* Du kennst die relevanten Datenschutzbestimmungen (z. B. DSGVO, Medizinprodukteverordnung) und setzt diese in der Entwicklung verantwortungsvoller KI\-Lösungen um.
* Du arbeitest gerne interdisziplinär und bringst Deine Expertise in die Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzten, MFAs und Produktteams ein, um klinische Relevanz sicherzustellen.
* Du bist kommunikativ, lösungsorientiert und bringst eine hohe Eigenmotivation sowie die Bereitschaft zur kontinuierlichen Weiterbildung mit.
* Sichere Deutschkenntnisse (C1\) runden Dein Profil ab.

#### **Das erwartet Dich bei uns**

* Mit einem **attraktiven Fixgehalt** wird Deine Leistung angemessen honoriert, sodass Engagement direkt sichtbar belohnt wird.
* **30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr** geben Dir ausreichend Zeit, um eine ausgewogene Work\-Life\-Balance zu genießen.
* Eine super flexible **Homeoffice\-Regelung** erlaubt es Dir, Arbeit und Privatleben optimal zu kombinieren.
* Wenn Du nicht vor Ort bist, kannst Du zwischen Homeoffice oder unserem Büro in Mannheim wählen.
* Spannende Teamevents sorgen für jede Menge Spaß und bringen das Team richtig zusammen.
* Ein engagiertes, kollegiales Team sowie ein professionelles Praxisteam an unseren Standorten, das dich unterstützt und willkommen heißt.
* Die Chance, im Jahr 2026 aktiv am dynamischen Wachstum unseres Unternehmens mitzuwirken und beruflich sowie persönlich zu wachsen – mit echtem Purpose.

#### **Interessiert?**


Möchtest Du die Zukunft der hausärztlichen Versorgung aktiv mitgestalten? Dann bewirb Dich direkt über den Button!

 **Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!**

* Zur besseren Lesbarkeit verwenden wir in unseren Texten teilweise das generische Maskulinum. Selbstverständlich sind dabei stets alle Geschlechter gleichermaßen gemeint. Die gewählte Form dient ausschließlich der sprachlichen Vereinfachung und beinhaltet keinerlei Wertung.

#### **Über uns**


LillianCare widmet sich der Herausforderung des Ärztemangels in Deutschland durch die Einrichtung hybrider Praxen landesweit, um überall qualitativ hochwertige Versorgung zu sichern. Wir setzen auf innovative Technologien, Teamarbeit und flexible Arbeitsmodelle, um exzellente Patientenbetreuung zu gewährleisten.  

  

Mit LillianCare kannst Du einen echten Unterschied machen und aktiv zur Bekämpfung des Ärztemangels in ländlichen Gebieten beitragen. Dieses bewährte Modell, das in anderen Ländern bereits erfolgreich umgesetzt wurde, bietet Dir die Möglichkeit, Deine Fähigkeiten optimal einzusetzen.

Are you looking to kickstart a career in data and AI? The Frontier AI Programme from Digital Futures is designed to equip you with the skills, confidence, and mindset to launch your career in AI.

The programme combines structured learning, industry certifications, and applied project experience into a single training journey. Our approach balances technical depth with practical application, ensuring individuals not only understand AI but can deploy it in real\-world contexts, and perform critical roles aligned to organisations transformation journey. Your journey begins with 12 weeks of free, full\-time training led by our expert instructors. We’ll equip you with the essential technical and consulting skills you need to thrive in your first data and AI role.

You'll earn an industry\-recognised certification aligned with one of our tech partners, including Google, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, and IBM. Digital Futures covers the full cost of your certification.

o Large Language Models

o Responsible AI

o Engineering AI Solutions

o Building Agents

o Agentic Orchestration

o Consultancy Skills

 Since our founding in 2017, Sonder has experienced rapid growth, expanding operations across Australia, New Zealand, and the UK. Backed by Australia’s leading venture capital firms, Seek and Blackbird, we are well\-capitalised and on a mission to scale globally, partnering with corporations, educational institutions, and government agencies to transform workplace wellbeing at scale. Our impact and scale: 1,000,000\+ members across multiple countries 200\+ team members, plus an extensive network of on\-the\-ground responders If you’re passionate about using technology and human expertise to drive meaningful change, join us in shaping the future of workplace wellbeing!
   

  

**About The Role**
 As our Staff Full Stack AI Software Engineer, you’ll play a critical role in setting the technical direction of Sonder’s platform. Beyond building features, you’ll influence architectural decisions, drive adoption of AI across the product suite, and mentor engineers to raise the overall technical bar. You’ll be expected to operate with autonomy, tackle ambiguous problems, and design solutions that scale across millions of users.
   

  

 You’ll work across the stack, from elegant front\-end experiences to distributed back\-end systems, embedding AI capabilities that make our support more intelligent, proactive, and personalised. As a Staff Engineer, you’ll also act as a technical thought partner to product and leadership teams, ensuring Sonder’s technology strategy aligns with our global mission.
   

  

**What You'll Bring To The Team**
 We're looking for a leader who is as excited about mentoring engineers and shaping strategy as they are about hands\-on coding. Your experience and mindset will be critical to our success, particularly in the rapidly evolving LLM space.
   

  

**Your Core Expertise**
* Staff\-level experience: You have a proven track record of operating as a Staff Engineer or in a similar leadership position, driving high\-impact technical initiatives across multiple teams and products.
* Full\-Stack Mastery: You are a full\-stack expert with significant experience in at least one modern front\-end framework (React, Angular, or Vue) and a strong back\-end language (Node.js, Python, or Java). You're comfortable building elegant, scalable solutions from end to end.
* Applied LLM Engineering: You have hands\-on, production\-level experience building and deploying applications that leverage Large Language Models (LLMs). This includes proficiency with Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and a solid understanding of how to manage and connect context.
* LLM Frameworks and Protocols: You are proficient with frameworks like LangChain, and are familiar with similar technologies such as LlamaIndex, Haystack, or Semantic Kernel. You have a strong understanding of emerging standards like the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and have practical experience implementing it or similar agentic architectures to connect LLMs to external tools and data sources.
* Advanced System Design: You have deep expertise in designing and architecting complex, distributed systems. You understand the unique challenges of integrating LLMs into a production environment, and know how to optimize for performance, reliability, and security at a massive scale.
* Cloud \& DevOps: You have a solid understanding of a major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and are a champion of modern DevOps practices, including CI/CD, containerization, and infrastructure\-as\-code.

* Alignment \& Communication: You excel at partnering with cross\-functional teams, from product managers to data scientists, to define technical strategies that align directly with business and product goals.
* Work Location and Working Rights: You have full working rights in Australia, and are comfortable working 2\-3 days out of our Waterloo office.

**Full\-time · Hybrid** 




  





 Firmable is the market\-leading B2B sales\-intelligence platform in Australia \& New Zealand — and we’re now scaling that success worldwide at speed. Backed by leading investors, we help businesses outperform by understanding more about their leads, customers and candidates than ever before.
 



 We’re building a team of curious, collaborative builders who thrive in fast\-moving start\-ups. This is your chance to
 **define how frontier AI gets applied to real customer problems** 
 — not just ship models, but set the playbook for how AI transforms sales intelligence globally.
 



  





 As
 **an Applied AI Engineer** 
 , you’ll partner with product and customers to uncover pain points, then rapidly prototype and prove out high\-value AI solutions. From LLM\-powered pipelines to graph\-aware recommenders, next\-best\-action agents and large\-scale semantic search, you’ll take ideas from “what if…” to working demos — and shape the blueprints our engineering teams scale into production.
 



  





**What you’ll do** 




  





**Discover \& prototype** 



* **Find the problems that matter** 
 — immerse yourself in sales workflows, customer calls and GTM feedback to uncover “if only…” moments.
* **Scout the frontier** 
 — track breakthroughs in LLMs, search paradigms, RAG, agentic workflows and continual\-learning models, and translate them into Firmable’s context.
* **Build fast, show fast** 
 — stand up reproducible prototypes in Python, integrating OpenSearch, Bedrock, Vertex AI, Anthropic, OpenAI or Hugging Face. Share clickable demos via Bolt, Cursor, Lovable or Vercel within hours, not weeks.
* **Measure what matters** 
 — design evaluation harnesses with offline metrics, simulation loops and toggle\-ready A/B flags. Optimise for accuracy, cost and latency with quantisation, distillation and prompt refinement.



  





**System design \& handover** 



* **Deliver reference implementations** 
 — clean notebooks, typed Python packages, prompt libraries and model cards with data lineage and dashboards — production\-ready by design.
* **Guide integration choices** 
 — advise Platform and Data Engineering on vector stores (Pinecone, Weaviate, PGVector, OpenSearch), feature stores, latency budgets and guardrails for both real\-time and batch use cases.
* **Bridge prototype to product** 
 — collaborate with engineering to turn experiments into scalable, reliable services.



  





**Evangelise \& lead** 



* **Shape the roadmap** 
 — surface and size the AI bets (semantic search, next\-best\-prospect ranking, large\-scale structured extraction) that unlock step\-changes in customer value.
* **Elevate the craft** 
 — run fortnightly AI guilds, publish internal playbooks on fine\-tuning, retrieval patterns and cost\-aware serving, and mentor engineers in modern ML tooling.



  





**What you bring** 




  





**Core Technical Skills** 



* Track record (5\+ years, or equivalent impact with a PhD \+ 3 years) building applied ML/AI prototypes that influenced shipped products or strategy.
* Proven track record of
 **fast\-paced idea to prototype,** 
 focusing on customer problems
* Expert in
 **Python** 
 and at least one deep\-learning framework (
 **PyTorch, JAX** 
 ).
* Hands\-on experience with
 **LLMs** 
 (transformer architecture, fine\-tuning, prompt engineering, RAG) and modern
 **search/relevance systems** 
 .
* Familiarity with
 **vector databases** 
 (Pinecone, Weaviate, PGVector, OpenSearch Vector) and large\-scale retrieval.
* Strong grounding in
 **experiment design \& evaluation** 
 ; able to communicate trade\-offs to technical and exec stakeholders.



  





**Mindset \& approach** 



* **First\-principles problem solver** 
 who thrives in ambiguity.
* **Product\-oriented builder** 
 — you care as much about solving customer pain as about model elegance.
* **Rapid experimenter** 
 — comfortable with scrappy prototypes and fast iteration.
* **AI\-first builder** 
 comfortable using tools like Cursor, Bolt, Lovable and Vercel \+ V0 for rapid iteration.
* **Continuous learner** 
 — excited to stay ahead of the curve in a fast\-moving AI field.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Publications, patents or open\-source contributions in ML/AI.
* Experience with B2B sales\-intelligence data, graph databases or large web crawls.
* Familiarity with cost\-aware ML ops (serverless inference, auto\-scaling, quantisation).
* Understanding of data privacy and compliance in large\-scale AI systems.



  





**Why you’ll love Firmable** 




  




* **Green\-field impact** 
 — define our applied\-AI playbook from scratch.

 — experiment on one of the largest proprietary business datasets in the world.

 — work flexibly and set core hours that suit your life.

 We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer to join our Artificial Intelligence team. This engineer will play a pivotal role in developing AI\-powered capabilities. title: Data and AI Engineer
description:
**\*\*Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship now or in the future.** 




  





 RevStar is a dynamic team of engineers, UX designers, and product managers committed to putting your business first in the pursuit of excellence. As an AWS Advanced Partner, we deliver cloud\-native web and mobile applications, building modern data and AI solutions that drive tangible value for our clients.
 



  





 We are passionate about what we build and how we build it. Our ethos is guided by Service, Collaboration, Transparency, Accountability, and Quality \- principles that underpin every role, from architecture and design to coding and delivery. We approach each project with an agile mindset, continuously analyzing goals and business needs to ensure optimal outcomes.
 



 At RevStar, our people are our greatest resource. We foster a collaborative, remote\-first culture where teams freely share ideas, innovate together, and grow both individually and collectively. By joining us, you’ll have the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies across diverse industries, delivering value\-driven products for clients who prioritize quality and performance. We believe in the pursuit of better, not just in cloud\-native app development, but in creating meaningful experiences and outcomes that matter.
 



  





 We are seeking an experienced Data \& AI Engineer to support the execution of our packaged QuickStarts, particularly those focused on GenAI (LLM Ops) and Data Lake architecture. This role will lead the development and deployment of scalable, production\-ready AI/ML solutions built on AWS\-native technologies.
 



  





**Role and Responsibilities** 



* Design, build, and deploy LLM\-based APIs using Amazon Bedrock, supporting models like Claude, Titan, Nova, and Cohere
* Implement retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines using OpenSearch \+ S3
* Build data pipelines for curated and raw data layers using AWS Glue, Athena, and Lake Formation
* Support real\-time reporting and AI usage dashboards via Amazon QuickSight
* Design serverless workflows using AWS Lambda and manage prompt metadata with DynamoDB
* Implement prompt orchestration strategies, including fallback handling, versioning, and safety guardrails
* Collaborate with product managers, architects, and DevOps to align AI/ML delivery with customer and project goals
* Document solutions clearly and support onboarding for handoff to client teams
* Stay current with AWS innovations in GenAI, MLOps, and scalable data platforms



 Please note that this job description is only a summary of the typical functions of the job, not an exhaustive or comprehensive list of all possible responsibilities, tasks, and duties.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, or related field
* 5\+ years of experience designing, building, and deploying cloud\-based ML or GenAI systems
* Deep hands\-on experience with AWS AI/ML services:
* Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, Glue, Athena, Lake Formation, OpenSearch, and QuickSight
* Strong Python development skills, with a focus on data manipulation, API development, and automation
* Experience implementing retrieval\-augmented generation, prompt orchestration, or LLMOps workflows preferred
* Familiarity with CI/CD, Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC), and Git\-based workflows
* Excellent communication skills and ability to explain AI system design and tradeoffs to both technical and business stakeholders



  





 If you're passionate about AI/ML and cloud technologies and want to work in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment, we'd love to hear from you!
 



  





**Working Environment** 




 The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced, consulting environment and is comfortable navigating ambiguity while leading client\-facing delivery. They are a proactive leader who asks the right questions, anticipates challenges, and drives clarity, while collaborating effectively across product, DevOps, and architecture teams. Reliability and clear communication are essential, particularly in a remote\-first culture that relies on Slack and Google Meet. This role is fully remote, with occasional on\-site client meetings each month, and requires availability during US working hours with active engagement on company communication channels. Above all, the candidate embodies RevStar’s core values of Service, Transparency, Accountability, Adaptability, and Teamwork.
 



  





**Company Benefits** 



* Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and stay productive.
* Remote\-First Working Environment – Collaborate from anywhere while staying connected with our global team.
* Comprehensive Health Coverage – Medical, Dental, Vision, FSA, HSA, Short\-Term \& Long\-Term Disability.
* Annual Learning \& Development Stipend – Invest in your skills with conferences, certifications, or courses.
* Peer Mentorship \& Coaching – Learn from experienced engineers, product managers, and architects to accelerate your growth.
* Professional Growth Opportunities – Exposure to cutting\-edge AWS GenAI, data, and cloud technologies across diverse industries.
* Company Outings \& Volunteer Opportunities – Build relationships and give back to the community.
* Collaborative, Innovative Culture – Work alongside top talent in a fast\-paced, supportive environment that values curiosity and initiative.



  





**Equal Opportunity Employment** 




 At RevStar, we don’t just accept differences — we celebrate them, we support them, and we thrive on them for the benefit of our employees, our customers, and our community. RevStar is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.
 



  





**\*\*Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship now or in the future.**

title: Senior Data Scientist/NLP (m/f/d)
description:
Posted 2 Days Ago Full time Germany \-Bonn **\+1 more** **location**

Position: Senior Data Scientist – Natural Language Processing (NLP)


Location: Bonn or Berlin (hybrid)


Fulltime


About the Role


LexisNexis Intellectual Property Solutions is seeking a highly skilled NLP Expert with proven expertise in semantic embeddings and knowledge graphs. This is a research\-driven, hands\-on role where you will design, build, and optimize language technologies that transform how customers search, analyze, and interact with intellectual property (IP) data.


About the Team


You will join a collaborative team of data scientists, AI engineers, and domain experts to push the boundaries of how semantic representations and graph\-based reasoning can enhance search, discovery, and predictive insights in the IP domain.


At LexisNexis, we value curiosity, innovation, and collaboration. You will be part of a vibrant community of data scientists and AI engineers, with dedicated time for continuous learning while also mentoring junior colleagues.


Responsibilities:

* state\-of\-the\-art techniques in embeddings, transformers, and generative language models to IP data.
* Design and enhance knowledge graph architectures to capture domain knowledge and enable advanced reasoning.
* Integrate embeddings and NLP methods with graph\-based systems to power knowledge\-driven insights.
* Prototype and validate new approaches, transitioning successful methods into production\-grade systems in collaboration with AI engineering teams.
* Mentor and support junior data scientists, fostering a collaborative and innovative culture.
* Stay current with state\-of\-the\-art NLP and graph research, applying and adapting new methods to real\-world problems in intellectual property.
* Contribute to the internal knowledge base by publishing technical reports, presenting at internal forums, and, where appropriate, authoring external publications or patents.
* Work with product managers and business stakeholders to deliver customer\-focused solutions with measurable impact.

  

Qualifications:

* Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Computational Linguistics, Artificial Intelligence, or related discipline.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience building NLP solutions in a research or commercial environment.
* Proven expertise in modern NLP techniques (e.g., semantic embeddings, transformer architectures, generative models) with experience evaluating, optimizing, and scaling NLP models.
* Strong experience with knowledge graph design, construction, and integration with NLP systems.
* Hands\-on skills in Python and modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow).
* Excellent problem\-solving and communication skills, with experience collaborating in cross\-functional, agile teams.

  

Preferred

* Familiarity with graph databases (Neo4j, RDF, SPARQL) and distributed knowledge graph systems.
* Publications, patents, or conference presentations in relevant NLP or ML venues.

  

Work in a way that works for you  

We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long\-term goals.

* Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.


About the Business


LexisNexis, a part of RELX, is a leading global provider of legal, regulatory, and business information. We help customers increase productivity and improve decision\-making and outcomes. Our 10,500 experts and innovative tools help us shape a better world for our customers and communities.

title: AI Engineer
description:
**Summary**

Are you looking to kickstart a career in data and AI? The Frontier AI Programme from Digital Futures is designed to equip you with the skills, confidence, and mindset to launch your career in AI.

**Frontier AI Programme**

The programme combines structured learning, industry certifications, and applied project experience into a single training journey. Our approach balances technical depth with practical application, ensuring individuals not only understand AI but can deploy it in real\-world contexts, and perform critical roles aligned to organisations transformation journey. The programme follows three key steps:

1\. Training

Your journey begins with 12 weeks of free, full\-time training led by our expert instructors. We’ll equip you with the essential technical and consulting skills you need to thrive in your first data and AI role.

2\. Certification

You'll earn an industry\-recognised certification aligned with one of our tech partners, including Google, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, and IBM. Digital Futures covers the full cost of your certification.

3\. Employment

Once you graduate, we'll deploy you into a data and AI role with one of our clients. Upon securing your deployment, you'll become a permanent employee of Digital Futures and begin working as a data and AI consultant one of the world’s most innovative companies.

**What You'll Learn**

Our Frontier AI Programme provides the critical technical and professional skills needed for a successful career in data and AI. The curriculum includes:

o AI \& Data Essentials

o Data Wrangling and Pipelines

o Large Language Models

o Responsible AI

o Engineering AI Solutions

o Building Agents

o AI \& Analytics

o Agentic Orchestration

o Consultancy Skills

**Key Programme Information**

o **Locations**: Roles with our clients are available across the UK, including London, Stevenage, Bristol, Norwich, Leeds, Sheffield, Halifax, and York. You must be willing to either commute to or relocate to one of these cities for your deployment.

o **Salary** (Once deployed to a client site. Please note that the training period is unpaid.):

o Year 1: £27,500 per annum, plus benefits

o Year 2: £32,000 per annum, plus benefits (subject to a performance review)

o **Benefits**: As a permanent Digital Futures employee, you’ll receive a comprehensive benefits package, pension contributions, and access to an Employee Referral Scheme.

o **Dates**: The full\-time programme runs Monday to Friday, from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.

o **Eligibility**: You must have the full right to work in the UK to apply.

**Who We're Looking For**

The Frontier AI Programme is open to people from all backgrounds. You don't need any formal experience or a tech background to apply. While we encourage you to have some self\-study in coding, our most successful applicants demonstrate four key traits: passion, curiosity, commitment, and ambition.

**Why Join Digital Futures?**

We're a mission\-driven technology services company dedicated to unlocking potential \- for individuals, for organisations, and for society. We have reimagined how capability is built in the age of AI, disrupting outdated workforce and education models and placing talent and ambition at our core. We work where the need is greatest and the stakes are highest, ensuring AI is deployed with purpose \- driving innovation and inclusive growth.

For our people, we are building a company that matters: one where pride is a strategic asset and our collective impact is measured in enduring outcomes \- opportunity created, futures transformed, advantage secured.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: From £27,500\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Company pension
* Employee discount
* Employee mentoring programme
* Health \& wellbeing programme
* Referral programme
* Relocation assistance
* Sick pay
* Store discount

Work Location: In person

Expected start date: 12/01/2026

Mott MacDonald is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy with over 20,000 employees across more than 50 countries and 140\+ offices.

  

We work across incredible global industries, delivering exciting work that is defining our future and making an important societal impact in the communities we serve. Our people power our performance – we succeed when they do. With countless opportunities to collaborate, learn, and grow, the possibilities for excellence are as varied as every individual.

  

Whether you want to grow as a subject matter expert or broaden your experience with roles across our international community, you’re surrounded by global specialists who want to combine their expertise and champion you to be your best. As a proudly employee\-owned business, we benefit our clients, our communities, and each other, investing in creating the right space for everyone to feel empowered, included, and valued. Whatever your ambition, Mott MacDonald is where people come to be **brilliant.**

  

About the business unit

  

Mott MacDonald’s support services are the driving force behind our organisation enabling us to run efficiently and effectively. The team works collaboratively to offer specialist advice, best practice and technology to all areas of our business specifically designed for our global reach.

  

Make a Difference. Grow Your Potential. Shape Our Societal Impact.

  

At Mott MacDonald, we believe that harnessing the power of AI and data can drive meaningful change—both for our clients and society as a whole. As an AI and Data Governance Advisor, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring our adoption of advanced technologies is responsible, inclusive, and impactful. You’ll guide teams on best practices, proactively manage risks, and champion ethical, secure, and effective use of AI and data.

  

Your Purpose and Contribution

 Ensure 24/7 uptime of scoring APIs serving banking clients; implement failover systems and load balancing.

 Oversee QA/UAT processes for model updates including back\-testing, shadow deployments, and canary releases.
* **Model Governance:** 
 Maintain audit trails for model versions, inputs/outputs, and performance metrics. Support Compliance and Audit with creation of logs when requested.
* **Incident Response:** 
 Lead troubleshooting of scoring engine failures with SLAs for financial institution clients.
* **Infrastructure Optimization:** 
 Tune AzureML/Databricks clusters for cost\-performance efficiency at scale.
* **Vendor Management:** 
 Ensure vendor support is completing work as per scope and SLAs. Rectifying any vendor delivery issues.

**Salary\- 30,000 \- 40,000 AED Per Month**

**About** 




 My client is a leading integrated healthcare company with operations across the UAE, UK, Europe and the US.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 As a Data Scientist in the AI team, you will be a critical technical expert responsible for the rigorous assessment and validation of third\-party AI solutions. Working closely with Product Managers, AI Architects, and domain experts, you will dive deep into vendor offerings, design innovative evaluation methodologies, and conduct hands\-on testing to verify claims, assess performance, and determine the suitability of these solutions for the clients' diverse needs (Provider, Payer, Enterprise, Consumer).
 



  





 Your role is not primarily to build AI models from scratch, but to be a discerning and creative evaluator. You will leverage your deep understanding of AI/ML principles, data analysis techniques, and validation frameworks to ensure that the customer invests in robust, effective, and ethically sound AI technologies.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* Conduct in\-depth technical reviews of AI vendor solutions, including their underlying methodologies, algorithms, data requirements, model architecture (where disclosed), and performance claims.
* Analyse vendor documentation, APIs, and technical specifications to understand solution capabilities and limitations
* Design and implement creative and robust evaluation frameworks and testing protocols for diverse AI solutions (e.g., predictive models, NLP tools, computer vision algorithms).
* Define appropriate performance metrics, statistical significance tests, and bias detection techniques relevant to specific use cases and solution types.
* Execute evaluation plans, including data preparation, feature engineering (for comparative analysis if needed), running vendor models/APIs, and analyzing outputs.
* Interpret complex evaluation results and translate them into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers to align technical validation with business requirements and POC objectives.
* Work with AI Architects and technical teams to understand integration feasibility and data pipeline requirements for evaluated solutions.



  





  





**Qualifications \& Experience:** 




  




* Master’s degree or PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, or a related quantitative field
* 3\-5\+ years of hands\-on experience as a Data Scientist or Machine Learning Engineer, with a strong portfolio of projects demonstrating expertise in AI/ML model development, evaluation, and deployment.
* Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in data science (e.g., Python, R) and relevant libraries (e.g., scikit\-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Pandas, NumPy).
* Solid understanding of a wide range of machine learning algorithms (classification, regression, clustering, NLP, computer vision) and their underlying mathematical principles.
* Demonstrable experience in designing and executing model validation strategies, including cross\-validation, A/B testing, and bias assessment.
* Strong statistical analysis skills and the ability to interpret model performance metrics critically
* Experience with data querying languages (e.g., SQL) and working with large datasets.



  





  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 




  




* Experience in the healthcare domain (Provider, Payer, Life Sciences, HealthTech) and familiarity with healthcare data (EHR, claims, imaging, \- omics)
* Experience evaluating third\-party AI/ML solutions or working with MLaaS platforms.
* Familiarity with ethical AI principles, fairness, accountability, and transparency (FAT) in machine learning
* Experience with cloud\-based ML platforms (e.g., AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, Google AI Platform).
* Understanding of data governance, data privacy
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical findings to diverse audiences



  





 Regards,

* Lead the design, development, and deployment of AI/ML solutions to enhance operational efficiency, reduce fraud, improve risk assessment, and enable personalized digital services in insurance and financial services.

 Machine Learning \& Deep Learning

 Model Deployment \& MLOps
 


* Productionizing models with automated pipelines: training, testing, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.

* Designing and optimizing prompts for LLMs and generative AI systems.
* Reranking outputs to improve relevance and accuracy of AI responses.
* Orchestrating multiple models or LLMs to solve complex workflows.



  





 Data Engineering \& Feature Engineering
 


* Data preprocessing, cleaning, and transformation for structured and unstructured data.
* Feature selection, feature creation, and dimensionality reduction.
* Integration of heterogeneous data sources (databases, APIs, documents, streaming data).

 n8n.

 NLP (claims text, policy documents, medical records), Computer Vision (scanned documents, medical imaging).

 AWS SageMaker, Azure AI, GCP Vertex AI (data residency compliant).
* **MLOps Tools:** 
 MLflow, Kubeflow, Docker, Kubernetes, Airflow.

 Insurance systems (CMS, TPAs, broker portals) and financial data models.

title: Senior Data Scientist - Quick Commerce
description:
**Company Description**  

  

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in over 70\+ countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We enable creative minds to deliver solutions that create impact within our ecosystem. We move fast, take action and adapt. No matter where you're from or what you believe in, we build, we deliver, we lead. We are Delivery Hero.  

  

**Job Description**  

We are on the lookout for a Senior Data Scientist to join our "Quick Commerce Growth Product Line” on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.


Be part of redefining how customers experience quick commerce. You’ll help build technology that scales our non\-food offerings, reaching new market segments and driving revenue growth. By innovating within our Quick Commerce Team, you’ll make Delivery Hero the go\-to platform for a broad range of products, helping us grow faster and deliver more value to customers around the world.


At Quick Commerce, we are building the next generation of ranking and personalization systems to power our global quick commerce business. We want every customer to have a truly personalized experience – from the very first search to the final checkout – enriched with live signals that reflect their real\-time needs.


As a Senior Data Scientist for Ranking, you will work side\-by\-side with Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, and Software Engineers to design, experiment with, and deliver advanced ranking solutions deployed across dozens of countries and millions of customers.


This is a role for someone who has already worked in the ranking domain at scale and is hungry to push boundaries further. You will drive hypotheses, run experiments, and bring multi\-stage ranking architectures into production with real business impact. If you’re a strong coder with a hacker mentality and thrive in high\-scale applied ML problems, we’d love to talk.


Your mission:

* Design, experiment, and deploy multi\-stage ranking systems that improve relevance, personalization, and user experience at global scale.
* Drive experimentation: formulate hypotheses, analyze A/B tests, and turn insights into production\-ready ranking models.
* Leverage live user signals and context to make ranking more adaptive and dynamic.
* Keep yourself up to date and apply state\-of\-the\-art ranking models to see what truly works best for our customers.
* Collaborate closely with MLEs and Engineers to ensure solutions are scalable, reliable, and fast in production.
* Contribute to the long\-term vision of ranking and personalization at QC, while delivering short\-term wins that unlock measurable business impact.
* Mentor and inspire peers, raising the quality bar for Data Science in ranking across the tribe.
* Contributions to the data science community (conference talks, papers, OSS).
* Experience mentoring other team members and driving knowledge sharing.

 **Qualifications**  

Your heroic skills:

* 5\+ years of industry experience applying Data Science and Machine Learning in production, ideally in large\-scale consumer\-facing applications.
* Deep expertise in ranking (multi\-stage pipelines, learning\-to\-rank, retrieval, blending, personalization) – ideally in e\-commerce, ads, search, or recommendation systems.
* Strong statistical foundations and ability to distinguish signal from noise in large\-scale experimentation.
* Excellent engineering skills: write clean, maintainable Python code; experience bringing ML models into production with best practices for observability, monitoring, and performance.
* Experience with large\-scale experimentation and A/B testing platforms.
* Proven ability to work cross\-functionally with engineers and product stakeholders, translating business problems into data science solutions.
* A hacker mentality: pragmatic, hands\-on, and comfortable iterating fast to get ranking solutions live.

  

Nice to have:

* Experience scaling ranking systems across multiple markets and heterogeneous platforms.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP preferred).
* Contributions to the data science community (conference talks, papers, OSS).
* Experience mentoring other team members and driving knowledge sharing.

description:
**About us** 




 RavenPack is the leading big data analytics provider for financial services. Financial professionals and organizations rely on RavenPack for its speed and accuracy in analyzing large amounts of unstructured content. Our products help clients enhance their decision\-making by quantifying the impact of media sentiment and attention.
 



  





 Our clients include the world’s most successful hedge funds, banks, and government agencies. As we continue to grow, we're looking for passionate, technically skilled professionals to join our Search Team.
 



  





**Join RavenPack:** 




 At RavenPack, our search engine is the gateway through which financial professionals access critical information. Our mission is to architect and build the most sophisticated, scalable, and intelligent search engine in the market, powering Bigdata.com.
 



 To make this gateway truly intelligent, we are looking for an insightful and experienced Senior Search Machine Learning Engineer \- NLP to join our Search Team. This is a strategic role designed for a scientist who is driven to understand the "why" behind every search, defining and building our relevance systems from the ground up. In an environment where user privacy is paramount, the intelligence of our search engine must come from a profound, first\-principles understanding of our content.
 



 You will own the full analytical and modeling lifecycle, from analyzing content and building gold\-standard benchmarks, to developing the next generation of our relevance, ranking, and query understanding models.
 



 This role is for a natural problem\-solver who combines scientific rigor with product intuition, and who is passionate about seeing their insights directly translate into a smarter, more intuitive search experience.
 



  





**European legal working status is required. Remote option available** 




  





**What You'll Be Doing** 



* Become an Expert on Content: Dive deep into our vast corpus of documents, understanding its intrinsic properties. Build and maintain benchmark datasets, to serve as the core for all our improvements and initiatives.
* Translate Query Intent into Search intelligence: Work on the development of our query understanding capabilities. Develop and fine\-tune a range of efficient Language Models for specialized tasks related to content enrichment and query understanding, such as Named Entity Recognition or topic classification.
* Build Advanced Relevance Features: Architect the features and models that power our core ranking and re\-ranking systems, using insights derived from deep content and query analysis.
* Own the Science of Search Evaluation: Champion a culture of data\-driven decision\-making. You will design and analyze offline experiments and tests to prove the impact of our work and guide the product roadmap.
* Collaborate on Product Strategy: Act as a strategic partner to Product Managers and Engineers. Gather and analyse user feedback, identifying their information needs. Your analysis and insights will be critical in identifying new opportunities and shaping the future direction of our search and discovery products.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* A Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics) and 4\+ years of professional experience in data science with a focus on Search or Recommender Systems.
* A proven track record of working on search relevance, ranking, query understanding or solving closely\-related NLP problems.
* Demonstrable, hands\-on experience building, fine\-tuning, and evaluating a range of language models for specific tasks like classification, NER, and semantic similarity.
* Experience in experimental design and statistical analysis. Expertise in creating evaluation datasets and developing relevance guidelines. You know how to ask the right questions and how to design experiments that provide clear, statistically significant answers.
* A talent for structuring ambiguous problems and applying logical reasoning, translating complex challenges into clear, actionable plans.
* High proficiency in Python and data science libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit\-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow, Hugging Face) and familiarity with SQL or other query languages.
* The ability to distill complex findings into clear, concise insights for diverse audiences, from engineers to executives. You are a collaborator by nature.



  





**Bonus Points:** 



* Direct experience in the financial services or financial data industry.
* Experience with knowledge graph construction.
* Experience analyzing data from search platforms like Vespa.



  





**What's in it for you?** 



* Growth Opportunity: Join a rapidly growing company with 180\+ team members with offices in New York, Madrid, and Marbella, building AI that truly matters for business and finance.
* International Culture: Be part of a diverse, global organization with a truly international culture.
* Team of Superstars: Work alongside a talented team of professionals, including Silicon Valley executives and Wall Street veterans.
* Competitive Compensation: We offer a highly competitive salary package and performance\-based bonuses.
* Relocation Assistance: Comprehensive relocation support is available to help you and your family move to the beautiful Costa del Sol.
* Work\-Life Balance: Enjoy paid vacation, flexible time\-off, and a flexible work policy.
* Continuous learning: We provide the support needed to grow within the team.

 Flatiron Health is a healthtech company using data for good to power smarter care for every person with cancer, around the world. Flatiron partners with cancer centers in the US, Europe and Asia to transform patients’ real\-life experiences into real\-world evidence and create a more modern, connected oncology ecosystem. Our multidisciplinary teams include oncologists, data scientists, software engineers, epidemiologists, product experts and more. Flatiron Health is an independent affiliate of the Roche Group.

 At Flatiron, we’re advancing the use of machine learning, generative AI, and natural language processing to extract clinically relevant information from unstructured medical notes for use in oncology research. The Data Curation team is helping to build these next generation research data products, developing and applying ML models to capture a complete picture of the patient journey
   

  

 As part of our team, you will develop and validate models to solve applied clinical problems and help build towards our vision of the future of machine learning at Flatiron. Engaging with a cross\-functional group of stakeholders across our teams in Europe, Japan, and the US you will contribute to model development projects from scoping through to productionization and delivery.

* Interface with internal scientific stakeholders and customers to understand what data they need to conduct high quality research.

* Work with quantitative scientists and oncologists to validate that your models can be used to generate sound scientific insights.
* Collaborate with other Data Scientists to accelerate our ML capabilities and develop novel approaches to clinical data extraction from unstructured health records.
* Work cross\-functionally with software engineers to productionize, scale, and monitor your models.


**Who You Are**
 You're a product\-focused data scientist, with experience in leveraging ML and NLP to solve real\-world problems. You're excited by the prospect of rolling up your sleeves to tackle meaningful problems each and every day. You’re a kind, passionate and collaborative problem\-solver who seeks and gives candid feedback, and values the chance to make an important impact.
   

  

  

* You have 3\+ years of relevant working experience in a technical capacity, with a focus on ML. Prior experience with NLP and LLMs is strongly preferred.
* You have a strong background in applying ML to solve real\-world problems and a solid grasp of the underlying statistical fundamentals of ML.
* You are excited to work in a startup environment, think creatively and be scrappy to get the job done. You have a nose for value and empathy for your customers
* You have collaborated with other technical team members in a production development environment using formal version control, Python, and SQL.
* You are proficient in English and German.


*Extra Credit (Optional to add extra credit)*
* You have ML experience in a healthcare setting.
* You have experience with the risks of bias in machine learning, health equity research/analysis or have worked with underrepresented groups in a clinical research setting.


 If this sounds like you, you'll fit right in at Flatiron.

title: Senior Search ML Engineer - NLP
description:
**About us** 




 RavenPack is the leading big data analytics provider for financial services. Financial professionals and organizations rely on RavenPack for its speed and accuracy in analyzing large amounts of unstructured content. Our products help clients enhance their decision\-making by quantifying the impact of media sentiment and attention.
 



  





 Our clients include the world’s most successful hedge funds, banks, and government agencies. As we continue to grow, we're looking for passionate, technically skilled professionals to join our Search Team.
 



  





**Join RavenPack:** 




 At RavenPack, our search engine is the gateway through which financial professionals access critical information. Our mission is to architect and build the most sophisticated, scalable, and intelligent search engine in the market, powering Bigdata.com.
 



 To make this gateway truly intelligent, we are looking for an insightful and experienced Senior Search Machine Learning Engineer \- NLP to join our Search Team. This is a strategic role designed for a scientist who is driven to understand the "why" behind every search, defining and building our relevance systems from the ground up. In an environment where user privacy is paramount, the intelligence of our search engine must come from a profound, first\-principles understanding of our content.
 



 You will own the full analytical and modeling lifecycle, from analyzing content and building gold\-standard benchmarks, to developing the next generation of our relevance, ranking, and query understanding models.
 



 This role is for a natural problem\-solver who combines scientific rigor with product intuition, and who is passionate about seeing their insights directly translate into a smarter, more intuitive search experience.
 



  





**European legal working status is required. Remote option available** 




  





**What You'll Be Doing** 



* Become an Expert on Content: Dive deep into our vast corpus of documents, understanding its intrinsic properties. Build and maintain benchmark datasets, to serve as the core for all our improvements and initiatives.
* Translate Query Intent into Search intelligence: Work on the development of our query understanding capabilities. Develop and fine\-tune a range of efficient Language Models for specialized tasks related to content enrichment and query understanding, such as Named Entity Recognition or topic classification.
* Build Advanced Relevance Features: Architect the features and models that power our core ranking and re\-ranking systems, using insights derived from deep content and query analysis.
* Own the Science of Search Evaluation: Champion a culture of data\-driven decision\-making. You will design and analyze offline experiments and tests to prove the impact of our work and guide the product roadmap.
* Collaborate on Product Strategy: Act as a strategic partner to Product Managers and Engineers. Gather and analyse user feedback, identifying their information needs. Your analysis and insights will be critical in identifying new opportunities and shaping the future direction of our search and discovery products.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* A Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics) and 4\+ years of professional experience in data science with a focus on Search or Recommender Systems.
* A proven track record of working on search relevance, ranking, query understanding or solving closely\-related NLP problems.
* Demonstrable, hands\-on experience building, fine\-tuning, and evaluating a range of language models for specific tasks like classification, NER, and semantic similarity.
* Experience in experimental design and statistical analysis. Expertise in creating evaluation datasets and developing relevance guidelines. You know how to ask the right questions and how to design experiments that provide clear, statistically significant answers.
* A talent for structuring ambiguous problems and applying logical reasoning, translating complex challenges into clear, actionable plans.
* High proficiency in Python and data science libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit\-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow, Hugging Face) and familiarity with SQL or other query languages.
* The ability to distill complex findings into clear, concise insights for diverse audiences, from engineers to executives. You are a collaborator by nature.



  





**Bonus Points:** 



* Direct experience in the financial services or financial data industry.
* Experience with knowledge graph construction.
* Experience analyzing data from search platforms like Vespa.



  





**What's in it for you?** 



* Growth Opportunity: Join a rapidly growing company with 180\+ team members with offices in New York, Madrid, and Marbella, building AI that truly matters for business and finance.
* International Culture: Be part of a diverse, global organization with a truly international culture.
* Team of Superstars: Work alongside a talented team of professionals, including Silicon Valley executives and Wall Street veterans.
* Competitive Compensation: We offer a highly competitive salary package and performance\-based bonuses.
* Relocation Assistance: Comprehensive relocation support is available to help you and your family move to the beautiful Costa del Sol.
* Work\-Life Balance: Enjoy paid vacation, flexible time\-off, and a flexible work policy.
* Continuous learning: We provide the support needed to grow within the team.

title: Senior Search ML Engineer - NLP
description:
**About us** 




 RavenPack is the leading big data analytics provider for financial services. Financial professionals and organizations rely on RavenPack for its speed and accuracy in analyzing large amounts of unstructured content. Our products help clients enhance their decision\-making by quantifying the impact of media sentiment and attention.
 



 Our clients include the world’s most successful hedge funds, banks, and government agencies. As we continue to grow, we're looking for passionate, technically skilled professionals to join our Search Team.
 



  





**Join RavenPack:** 




 At RavenPack, our search engine is the gateway through which financial professionals access critical information. Our mission is to architect and build the most sophisticated, scalable, and intelligent search engine in the market, powering Bigdata.com.
 



 To make this gateway truly intelligent, we are looking for an insightful and experienced Senior Machine Learning engineer \- NLP to join our Search Team. This is a strategic role designed for a scientist who is driven to understand the "why" behind every search, defining and building our relevance systems from the ground up. In an environment where user privacy is paramount, the intelligence of our search engine must come from a profound, first\-principles understanding of our content.
 



 You will own the full analytical and modeling lifecycle, from analyzing content and building gold\-standard benchmarks, to developing the next generation of our relevance, ranking, and query understanding models.
 



 This role is for a natural problem\-solver who combines scientific rigor with product intuition, and who is passionate about seeing their insights directly translate into a smarter, more intuitive search experience.
 



  





**European legal working status is required.** 




  





**What You'll Be Doing** 



* Become an Expert on Content: Dive deep into our vast corpus of documents, understanding its intrinsic properties. Build and maintain benchmark datasets, to serve as the core for all our improvements and initiatives.
* Translate Query Intent into Search intelligence: Work on the development of our query understanding capabilities. Develop and fine\-tune a range of efficient Language Models for specialized tasks related to content enrichment and query understanding, such as Named Entity Recognition or topic classification.
* Build Advanced Relevance Features: Architect the features and models that power our core ranking and re\-ranking systems, using insights derived from deep content and query analysis.
* Own the Science of Search Evaluation: Champion a culture of data\-driven decision\-making. You will design and analyze offline experiments and tests to prove the impact of our work and guide the product roadmap.
* Collaborate on Product Strategy: Act as a strategic partner to Product Managers and Engineers. Gather and analyse user feedback, identifying their information needs. Your analysis and insights will be critical in identifying new opportunities and shaping the future direction of our search and discovery products.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* A Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics) and 4\+ years of professional experience in data science with a focus on Search or Recommender Systems.
* A proven track record of working on search relevance, ranking, query understanding or solving closely\-related NLP problems.
* Demonstrable, hands\-on experience building, fine\-tuning, and evaluating a range of language models for specific tasks like classification, NER, and semantic similarity.
* Experience in experimental design and statistical analysis. Expertise in creating evaluation datasets and developing relevance guidelines. You know how to ask the right questions and how to design experiments that provide clear, statistically significant answers.
* A talent for structuring ambiguous problems and applying logical reasoning, translating complex challenges into clear, actionable plans.
* High proficiency in Python and data science libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit\-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow, Hugging Face) and familiarity with SQL or other query languages.
* The ability to distill complex findings into clear, concise insights for diverse audiences, from engineers to executives. You are a collaborator by nature.



  





**Bonus Points:** 



* Direct experience in the financial services or financial data industry.
* Experience with knowledge graph construction.
* Experience analyzing data from search platforms like Vespa.



  





**What's in it for you?** 



* Growth Opportunity: Join a rapidly growing company with 180\+ team members with offices in New York, Madrid, and Marbella, building AI that truly matters for business and finance.
* International Culture: Be part of a diverse, global organization with a truly international culture.
* Team of Superstars: Work alongside a talented team of professionals, including Silicon Valley executives and Wall Street veterans.
* Competitive Compensation: We offer a highly competitive salary package and performance\-based bonuses.
* Relocation Assistance: Comprehensive relocation support is available to help you and your family move to the beautiful Costa del Sol.
* Work\-Life Balance: Enjoy paid vacation, flexible time\-off, and a flexible work policy.
* Continuous learning: We provide the support needed to grow within the team.
